subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should these 13 action revisions land as one grouped update after refreshed exact-head validation, or should the secret-bearing and release/security actions be reviewed and landed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it replaces third-party executable code across token minting, Codex API access, security scanning, and image publishing; only repository owners can accept that combined trust-boundary and operational blast radius.

options.title: Approve refreshed grouped update
options.body: Rebase to current main, resolve or explain the failed exact-head checks, then obtain security and workflow-owner approval for the complete immutable-pin set.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions from lower-risk repository automation so each trust boundary can be validated and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the dependency rollup
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until owners have capacity to review the upstream executable changes and privileged workflow behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve refreshed grouped update
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, resolve or explain the failed exact-head checks, then obtain security and workflow-owner approval for the complete immutable-pin set.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans CI action-version policy, Docker workflows, and Codex-agent workflow maintenance.
